localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
This small, wooded group camp has a minimum occupancy of 20 people and a maximum of 65 people. Groups with over 65 people may have part or all of their group cited and evicted. Minimal parking is located within the group camp area. A small parking lot is located about 20 yards from the group camp entrance. Groups are allowed a maximum of 25 vehicles total. No more than 10 of the total vehicles may include RVs, and no utility hookups are available.
This group camping area features a small shelter, vault toilet, and barbecues. It is a rustic, wooded area best suited for tents. Up to 10 RVs may be allowed, but parking is limited. Call the park for more details.

localizedValues.name: G2
localizedValues.description:
This field group camp has a minimum occupancy of 20 people and a maximum of 85 people. Groups with over 85 people may have part or all of their group cited and evicted. Groups are allowed a maximum of 35 vehicles total. No more than 15 of the total vehicles may include RVs, and no utility hookups are available. All vehicles must park in the lot designated for the group camping area.
This group camping area features a large grass area ideal for tents. Groups staying longer than 2 nights may be asked to move their tents to reduce browning on lawn areas. There is a fire pit for use when campfires are permitted and a stand-alone water faucet. A limited number of RVs may be allowed. Call the park for more details.
